points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable curated 47dff36 clean CMake build succeeds with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB, /opt/external dependencies; no CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses --case/--output/--restart; solver.cpp:896–985 serializes current and two previous states and physical time. Rank-0 restart read errors return before peers reach broadcasts, risking MPI hang.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case, mesh, partition, reconstruction, physics, solver and output modules; state/geometry remain strictly 2-D.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper identified; external authorship/similarity search excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp accepts configured mesh path; mesh.cpp:68 reads CGNS rather than branching solely on two filenames. Only supplied meshes evidenced.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:112–127 loads full Mesh on every rank and retains it through iterations, contrary to TASK.md:227. METIS and neighbor exchanges exist; np4/8 output differences are recorded.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp positivity fallback and finite checks exist, but actual BDF2 formula and log-y plotting fail; solver.cpp:928–941 root restart error can bypass subsequent MPI broadcasts.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: mesh_diag tool and contestant np4/np8 plus clean-checkout audit provide evidence; no independent formal convergence suite or evaluator CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source/report omit raw results intentionally; generated plots show systematic log-coordinate bug and source contains optional debug controls.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
